scientific_question: Within Lepidoptera, does out-of-species spatial-genetic transfer increase continuously with ecological similarity after geographic co-support is controlled?

domain.trait_panel: major-complete exact-name LepTraits species after excluding every species from the prior 250-species identity-opened route plus the operator-exposure exception
domain.formal_species_count: determined response-blind by the frozen design builder before synthetic outcomes; must be >=180 or stop
domain.split: SHA256('lepidoptera-trait-transfer-v0.1|major_complete|species'), lower half train and upper half evaluation

baseline.name: within_lepidoptera_geography_conditioned_transfer
baseline.definition: For each evaluation species, predict post-IBD edge turnover from all geographically supported training Lepidoptera using the unchanged core TTF field and equal total species weight; score by Spearman correlation with target post-IBD turnover.
baseline.panel_statistic: arithmetic mean across response-blind supported evaluation species
baseline.role: second rung between the completed all-animal unconditional baseline and the trait-gradient estimand

trait_gradient.name: trait_similarity_transfer_gradient_v0.1
trait_gradient.unit: target-source species pair within the target geographic support pool

trait_axes.wing_size: exp(-absolute difference in panel-standardized log1p wing-size proxy)
trait_axes.host_breadth: exp(-absolute difference in panel-standardized log1p NumberOfHostplantFamilies)
trait_axes.habitat: mean exact-category similarity across CanopyAffinity, EdgeAffinity, MoistureAffinity, DisturbanceAffinity

trait_gradient.composite_similarity: arithmetic mean of the four frozen axis similarities
trait_gradient.source_specific_transfer_contribution: Spearman correlation between target synthetic edge response and response-blind nearest-edge-aligned source synthetic edge response
trait_gradient.geographic_control: Within each target support pool, regress pairwise trait similarity on an intercept plus target-source coverage, centroid distance, edge-count ratio and locality-count ratio; use the residual similarity as the gradient predictor.
trait_gradient.primary_statistic: For each evaluation target, through-origin slope of source-specific transfer contribution on residualized trait similarity; panel statistic is the equal-target arithmetic mean of those slopes.
trait_gradient.inference: two-sided centered target-cluster bootstrap; 1999 resamples; alpha=0.05
trait_gradient.positive_claim: Within Lepidoptera, ecologically more similar species share more reusable post-IBD spatial-genetic structure beyond geographic co-support.

private_null.construction: species loadings on shared spatial basis fields are independent across species
private_null.requirement: among 500 worlds, Wilson 95% upper bound of two-sided rejection rate <=0.10

trait_gradient_positive.construction: species loadings have covariance given by the frozen composite trait-similarity kernel, blended 0.85 with 0.15 independent variance
trait_gradient_positive.requirement: among 500 worlds, positive-direction two-sided rejections have Wilson 95% lower bound >=0.80

geometry_confounded_trap.construction: species loadings have covariance given only by a response-blind geometry RBF kernel, blended 0.85 with 0.15 independent variance; trait similarity has no role in world generation
geometry_confounded_trap.requirement: among 500 worlds, Wilson 95% upper bound of two-sided rejection rate <=0.10

stopping_rules: Do not inspect or compute empirical Lepidoptera nucleotide-identity transfer outcomes before all three synthetic cells pass.

Do not alter trait axes, composite rule, geographic covariates, support radius, coverage threshold, minimum source count, alpha, bootstrap count, panel split, simulator kernel blend or formal seed namespace after any formal synthetic outcome is inspected.
If any cell fails, retire trait_similarity_transfer_gradient_v0.1. Any replacement must receive a new estimator version and a disjoint synthetic seed namespace.
The formal panel must exclude all 250 species from the prior identity-opened Phase-1 route, not merely its 211 survivors.
Do not use the prior v0.2/v0.3 confirmatory geometry as the empirical confirmation panel for this new estimand.
